run_shard_and_shuffle_cli: run the shard_and_shuffle module via hydra cli to split and shuffle a large text file into multiple compressed shards
run_async_shard_and_shuffle: call the async shard_and_shuffle function with a ShardAndShuffleConfig and launcher to shard and shuffle an input file
use_shard_and_shuffle_mc_process_lines: use ShardAndShuffleMC.process_lines to randomly distribute input lines across multiple output shards with optional sampling with replacement
use_shard_and_shuffle_mc_merge_results: use ShardAndShuffleMC.merge_results to merge per-chunk shard splits into final compressed shard files
configure_shard_and_shuffle_config: create a ShardAndShuffleConfig dataclass with launcher, nb_shards, output_dir, and input_file to configure the sharding pipeline
